name: Nigel Wooden
headline: Managing Director at DWR - NetSuite Partner
about:
DWR helps businesses become more efficient and profitable through using the world’s leading cloud-based business platform, Netsuite.

From our Sydney base we provide a total software solution for our clients that brings positive impact to every aspect of their operations. This solution is delivered using a 'turn-key' methodology which follows a proven formula of planning, scoping, design, implementation, training and end user assistance.

We’ve assisted businesses in a host of different industries including Professional Services, Hospitality, Retail, Wholesale, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, Agribusiness, Insurance and eCommerce.

With over 20 years experience in implementing business software solutions and a proven methodology, DWR ensures that our clients get maximum impact and ROI when they implement a new operating platform.

The Netsuite platform ensures visibility, consistency and efficiency (of data, business processes and workflows) which guarantees our customers have complete control of their finances, production, scheduling, distribution, sales, customer service and payroll ... in real time, accessible from any web enabled device.

My early career, spent working for a number of dynamic businesses, has given me a genuine appreciation in using innovation to improve efficiency. An accountant by trade, my earlier roles involved researching and developing systems that saved business both time and money while improving staff engagement. Coupled with my interest in technology, I've bought this experience into my own business, which goes above solving a single requirement and actually enhances every aspect of my clients day-to-day business operations.

I lead a strong team from a range of backgrounds that ensures that DWR is equipped to provide solutions to a variety of business sizes and models regardless of the industry.
